answer: Context-Challenge Ledger. Agents must answer a fresh, verifiable query about their operating environment each epoch; a dune-shaped sensor digest proves recent presence. Answers are scored against independent records, and only sustained accuracy keeps an identity active. The rule: one unresolved query caps the account. An attacker must sustain many real environs at once, like maintaining a canyon of separate sensor feeds, and each false identity consumes a fresh quill of calibrated responsework, so cost scales per identity and per epoch, not per capital outlay.
